summary: No substantiated finding after an independent recheck of the accepted, review-enriched audit: all 199 target entries, 306 citation occurrences (231 distinct declarations), 38 layer verdicts and 77 recorded overlap claims. The distinctions between existing algebraic ingredients and missing K-theoretic constructions survive the attack.

Read every one of the 231 distinct cited declaration statements in 158 files at Mathlib 082e2d37e8b0463410cdb532e111cd43d5a66174 and Tau Ceti f790474821cf4256814db967cb154e7af3d0c369, with the surrounding variable/include/omit hypotheses, and compared every citation's fit and target note. All 306 library/name/file/line tuples resolve exactly in the pinned declaration index.

Re-searched absent targets and missing parts in both declarations.tsv and the whole pinned Lean trees using 25 concept families: higher K/Grothendieck groups; Steinberg/Milnor/Dennis–Stein; universal central extensions; stable GL/elementary groups/Whitehead; block sums; Mennicke/stable range/Dieudonne determinant; residues/transfer/Weil reciprocity; norm-residue/Hilbert/local invariants; Kummer/Tate twists/Chern; Hurewicz/plus/classifying spaces; Bloch/cross-ratios/dilogarithms; configuration complexes/homological stability; Quillen/Brauer lifting/Bott/Adams; rigidity/Bocksteins; Hochschild/cyclotomic traces/de Rham–Witt; K-completion; stable projectives/idempotents; finite-projective monoidal structures; K0 products/rank; exterior projectives; lambda/gamma operations; determinant/Pic/Steinitz; scheme K/perfect complexes/projective bundles; scheme Picard groups; S-units.

Adversarial hypothesis checks included commutative-ring transvections versus general-ring stable K1, finite-rank generation versus stable quotients, free-extension transfer versus projective-extension K1 transfer, finite-presentation/flatness for rankAtStalk, division-ring K0 and its category transport, and connected-component hypotheses in the semilocal discussion.

Resolved tempting false positives by reading their actual constructions: EG is not a completed BG/plus/K3 comparison; Clifford algebra periodicity is not topological K-theory Bott periodicity; numerical-type Picard groups are not scheme Picard groups; LineBundleClass is a CommMonoid without inverses; divisor evaluation/moving lemmas are not Weil reciprocity; S-unit finite generation is not the rank formula.
Compared all 38 accepted layer records with data/library-coverage.json: job, verdict, ordered target/library/note records and duplicate records agree exactly.

Resolved all 77 overlap references and read all 53 distinct destination descriptions. Checked shared owners and consumer-only restatements, including the added H.3 and N.1 references, and independently searched the atlas for omitted overlaps using the batch's K-theory, symbol, topology, trace and arithmetic vocabulary. No evidenced ownership error or unrecorded duplicated construction was established.
